description: This file defines the 'InvokableMethodProxyBaseId' struct within the 'Orleans.CodeGenerator' namespace. The struct is used to identify a proxy base, including whether it is an extension, and to generate class names or aliases based on the proxy type.

classes.name: InvokableMethodProxyBaseId
classes.description: A readonly struct that identifies a proxy base type and whether it's an extension, used in code generation for the Orleans framework.

properties.name: ProxyBaseType
properties.description: Gets the proxy base type, e.g., 'GrainReference'.

properties.name: IsExtension
properties.description: Indicates whether the descriptor represents an extension.

properties.name: CompositeAliasComponents
properties.description: Components of the compound type alias referring to this proxy base.

properties.name: GeneratedClassNameComponent
properties.description: String used in generated class names to distinguish this proxy base.

methods.name: InvokableMethodProxyBaseId
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the proxy base ID, checking that the type is an original definition and setting alias components and class name parts accordingly.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Provides hash code for the instance.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns the generated class name component.
